intro: Nordiska Solutions empowers cleantech innovators to scale globally and compete with confidence. We accelerate the international expansion of Nordic and global cleantech companies, turning breakthrough technologies into commercial success in high-growth markets.

With over 25 years of experience in cleantech, water, wastewater, and process technologies, we combine deep industry knowledge with strong international business expertise. We align strategy with execution — ensuring your solutions gain real market traction, not just presence.
From market entry strategy and intelligence to hands-on go-to-market execution and channel development, we deliver practical, results-driven support at every stage.
Through our global networks and direct access to buyers, EPC contractors, and key decision-makers, we remove the barriers to international growth.
Nordiska Solutions is more than a consultant — we are your strategic partner in turning sustainable innovation into global impact.
values: Our values define how we work and how we create impact. We pursue excellence by consistently exceeding expectations with quality and commitment. Through close collaboration with our clients and partners, we build strong relationships that deliver lasting results. We act with integrity, standing firm in our principles even in challenging situations. Innovation drives us to create customer-focused solutions that respond to evolving global needs. And through inclusivity, we value every voice and foster shared success.
